name: GitHub Workbench
description: Automate GitHub PR review and issue handling in Paseo: a board covering your repos and PRs/issues you authored elsewhere, a sidebar pending badge, an editable pre-dispatch panel, follow-up comments in the original agent, language-adaptive write-back, worktree auto-archival, optional external-PR reply drafting, then merge or comment back.

zh-CN.name: GitHub 工作台
zh-CN.description: 在 Paseo 中自动化 GitHub PR 评审与 Issue 处理：看板覆盖名下仓库与你在别人仓库提的 PR/issue，侧边栏未处理徽章，派发面板可编辑提示词与 agent 配置，新评论复用原 agent 跟进，回写语言自适应，worktree 自动归档，外部 PR 回复起草（可选），再合并或评论回写。
